## Why an Elastic IP matters here

A reverse proxy that terminates TLS (see [Configure SSL](configure-ssl.qmd)) needs a hostname that reliably points at the instance. An Elastic IP is worth allocating before you create that DNS record, because without one a stopped and restarted instance comes back with a new public address, and the record goes stale until someone notices and repoints it.
